cycle.note: Iowa licenses renew every July 1. CPE: 120 hours, 4 of them ethics, in the three years ending the December 31 before renewal (you may use June 30 instead). No yearly minimum.

requirements.label: Three-year total
requirements.note: 120 hours in the three calendar years ending December 31 (481 IAC 1030.5). New licensees: 40 per full year licensed.

requirements.label: Financial statement presentation
requirements.note: If you supervise compilations or sign compilation reports: 8 hours of financial statement presentation per three years.

requirements.label: Self-study
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than half the hours (60) from self-study.

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: At least 4 hours of ethics and rules of professional conduct per three years.

practiceOptions.label: Supervise compilations or sign compilation reports

licenseDateHint: Iowa licenses renew every July 1. CPE is tracked by calendar year.
issueDateHint: New licensees: none in the first 12 months, then 40 hours for each full year licensed.
limitsNotTracked: Non-technical skills, teaching and professional exams: each max 50%.
Meal meetings of 2 hours or less: max 25%.
You can use the three years ending June 30 instead of December 31.
recordRetention: Keep CPE records for 3 years after submitting the report that claims them.
toVerify: New licensees measured from the license date (the rule uses the application filing date).
